text: Guidehouse, the D.C. United front-of-kit sponsor, is a consultancy that was acquired by Bain Capital Private Equity from Veritas Capital in a $5.3 billion deal that closed in December 2023.
short: Guidehouse is owned by Bain Capital Private Equity.

source.name: Guidehouse newsroom - completion of transaction with Bain Capital
source.quote: announced the close of its acquisition by Bain Capital Private Equity ("Bain Capital") from Veritas Capital ("Veritas") for $5.3 billion.
